scope: Three proposed chapters, 12 lessons; planning and research only. No page/code/catalog/deployment/kernel installation performed.

independent_findings.finding: Frozen GENET lacks native XDP and AF_XDP zero-copy driver hooks.
independent_findings.evidence: No xdp/xsk symbols in bcmgenet.c/.h; net_device_ops has neither ndo_bpf nor ndo_xsk_wakeup.
independent_findings.resolution: Main route explicitly generic/SKB XDP plus AF_XDP copy; native and zero-copy only conceptual comparison.

independent_findings.finding: Actual packaged baseline disables CONFIG_XDP_SOCKETS. Namespace/veth cannot repair this.
independent_findings.resolution: Dedicated 13.3 builds uniquely named enabled kernel with side-by-side boot/module/DTB/overlay profile, reader rollback, and explicit enabled Linux alternative.

independent_findings.finding: Standard kernel install recipes can overwrite shared DTBs/overlays, breaking clean stock rollback.
independent_findings.resolution: Final plan explicitly preserves stock kernel/modules/DTB/overlays and all selections, and requires firmware-supported separate paths validated during implementation.

independent_findings.finding: 11.1 initially required application packet before 11.2 introduced endpoint.
independent_findings.resolution: 11.1 now uses bounded existing connectivity tools; numbered application begins 11.2.

independent_findings.finding: AF_XDP sockets must match actual receive device and queue.
independent_findings.resolution: 13.4 explicitly discovers queues and maps matching sockets; namespace uses simple specified topology.

independent_findings.finding: Capture rings, AF_XDP copy and userspace PMDs have different stack/copy/kernel involvement.
independent_findings.resolution: Plan teaches three axes, separate passive capture comparison and matched responder comparison, and qualifies DPDK bifurcated/kernel-backed PMDs.

scope_coverage.hardware_and_diagrams: Physical MAC/PHY/connector/Wi-Fi labels separate from conceptual CPU/RAM/DMA layout.
scope_coverage.progression: Normal UDP and checked frame decoder precede real GENET source tracing, mapped capture, selective generic XDP, kernel feature enablement, AF_XDP RX/TX ownership and comparison.
scope_coverage.hardware_feasibility: Existing Mac and Pi4 plus cable/reachable LAN port suffice; no W5500, extra board or Mac Ethernet adapter assumed. Software-only namespace path has explicit limits.
scope_coverage.management_and_cleanup: Namespace-first active experiments, discovered interfaces/routes, separate Wi-Fi SSH management for physical repeat, owned attachment identity, stock-profile return and offline boot rollback.
scope_coverage.verification: Fixtures and sanitizers, Linux/BPF builds, privileged verifier/namespace runtime, enabled-kernel artifact checks, failure/recovery, per-page independent reviews, rendered/public checks.
scope_coverage.honesty: No physical runtime, Pi boot, zero-copy, throughput or privileged runtime pass inferred from source inspection or compilation.

remaining_implementation_gates: Pin actual compatible Linux/libxdp/libbpf/clang versions and validate exact build commands.
Validate separate firmware kernel/DTB/overlay selections and rollback before publishing install instructions.
Execute privileged namespace/BPF/AF_XDP integration on an explicitly enabled Linux kernel; capability skips are not passes.
Compile enabled Pi kernel and verify output/config/release artifacts; actual Pi boot and physical networking remain reader-exercised until observed.
hardware_status: No physical hardware runtime performed; no current Pi kernel configuration remotely inspected.
